inspiration.observed_pattern: A phonetic name-normalization routine keeps consonant groups distinct across ignored letters while collapsing adjacent repeated Soundex codes.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to one independently authored MariaDB SOUNDEX scalar query for Ashcraft, whose h separates the initial s and c characters without resetting the prior consonant code; the source function and data are not copied.

fixture_notes: Ashcraft isolates the state transition where an ignored h must not reset the preceding Soundex consonant code.
determinism_notes: The query has no external state, clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
